summary_1line: Sanjaya recounts Drona taking command and promising to capture Yudhishthira alive if Arjuna can be drawn away from the battlefield.

image_candidates.scene_text: Drona, standing in a chariot before the assembled Kaurava army, promises Duryodhana he will seize Yudhishthira if Arjuna is kept away.
Duryodhana secretly confers with Karna and Duhsasana before asking Drona to capture Yudhishthira alive instead of killing him.
Sanjaya narrates the plan while the Kaurava troops spread the news that Drona has vowed to capture Yudhishthira.
